title: Reducto Releases r-1: A Single Pass Document Parsing Model That Cuts Errors 20% at 1 Cent Per Page
summary: We look at r-1, the document parsing model Reducto released on September 1, 2026. We walk through how it folds OCR, layout detection, tables, formatting and grounding into one full page pass, replacing the multi stage agentic pipeline it ships alongside. We break down the two numbers that matter for a migration decision: a reported 20% error reduction and a flat 1 cent per page rate against the legacy 3 to 6 cents.
